# Auth (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Sign-in, sessions, roles and permissions, segregation of duties, act as, members-only engagements and single sign-on.

## Files

- `access-routes.ts`: Engagement access API: open or members-only, and who the members are.
- `access.ts`: Per-engagement access.
- `auth-routes.ts`: Sign-in, sessions, your account and the People and roles page.
- `auth.ts`: Sign-in, sessions and permission checks.
- `sso.ts`: Single sign-on (OpenID Connect), scaffolded.
